description: Na₃IrH₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven H atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.49 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten H atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.62 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven H atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.62 Å. Ir is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six H atoms. There are a spread of Ir-H bond distances ranging from 1.66-1.68 Å. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Ir atom. In the second H site, H is bonded to four Na and one Ir atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing HNa₄Ir square pyramids. In the third H site, H is bonded to four Na and one Ir atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing HNa₄Ir square pyramids. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Ir atom.
